events.title: NVIDIA and Elith release Japanese finance personas and PII documents
events.title_zh: NVIDIA 与 Elith 发布日本金融 persona 与 PII 文档集
events.published_at_note: The official Hugging Face article provides the date 2026-11-09 but no publication time.
events.summary: NVIDIA and Elith released two CC BY 4.0 Japanese synthetic-data resources: Nemotron-Personas-Finance-Japan with 9 million natural-language personas derived from one million structured records, and Nemotron-PII-Japan with 100,000 labeled synthetic business documents. The datasets target financial-agent simulation, localization, PII detection and redaction without using customer records.
events.summary_en: NVIDIA and Elith released two CC BY 4.0 Japanese synthetic-data resources: Nemotron-Personas-Finance-Japan with 9 million natural-language personas derived from one million structured records, and Nemotron-PII-Japan with 100,000 labeled synthetic business documents. The datasets target financial-agent simulation, localization, PII detection and redaction without using customer records.
events.summary_zh: NVIDIA 与 Elith 发布两套 CC BY 4.0 的日语合成数据。Nemotron-Personas-Finance-Japan 从 100 万条结构化记录生成 900 万个自然语言 persona；Nemotron-PII-Japan 提供 10 万份带标注的合成商务文档。它们用于金融 agent 模拟、本地化、PII 检测与脱敏，不需要客户记录。
events.why_it_matters: For teams building Japanese financial AI, the release lowers the cost of creating localized simulation and privacy tests with commercially usable data. Synthetic data reduces direct exposure to customer records, but it does not prove demographic fidelity, privacy safety, model quality or regulatory compliance.
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams building Japanese financial AI, the release lowers the cost of creating localized simulation and privacy tests with commercially usable data. Synthetic data reduces direct exposure to customer records, but it does not prove demographic fidelity, privacy safety, model quality or regulatory compliance.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对开发日本金融 AI 的团队来说，这套可商用数据降低了本地化模拟与隐私测试的准备成本。合成数据能减少直接接触客户记录，但不等于人口分布准确、没有隐私风险、模型质量更高或天然合规。

events.title: HiVe-Mem broadens multimodal memory retrieval while cutting context use
events.title_zh: HiVe-Mem 扩展多模态记忆并压缩上下文
events.summary: HiVe-Mem separates multimodal agent memory into relational recall expansion and per-memory evidence selection across summaries, raw interactions, images and grounded views. The authors report gains across three benchmarks and about 90% lower token use than the most efficient multimodal baseline. Code is available under MIT.
events.why_it_matters: For teams building long-lived multimodal agents, this provides a runnable way to control recall breadth separately from evidence granularity. Results are author-reported, and some upstream datasets carry non-commercial terms.
events.summary_zh: HiVe-Mem 将多模态 agent 记忆拆成两步：先沿文本和视觉关系扩展召回，再为每条记忆选择摘要、原始对话、图片或局部视觉证据。作者在三套 benchmark 上报告跨基础模型提升，并称 token 用量比最省的对照方法低约 90%。代码以 MIT 许可证公开。
events.summary_en: HiVe-Mem separates multimodal agent memory into relational recall expansion and per-memory evidence selection across summaries, raw interactions, images and grounded views. The authors report gains across three benchmarks and about 90% lower token use than the most efficient multimodal baseline. Code is available under MIT.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对构建长期多模态 agent 的团队来说，这提供了可运行的“召回范围与证据粒度分开控制”方案；结果仍来自论文作者，且部分上游数据带非商用限制。
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams building long-lived multimodal agents, this provides a runnable way to control recall breadth separately from evidence granularity. Results are author-reported, and some upstream datasets carry non-commercial terms.

technical_details.method: Cross-Episode Affinity Graph plus PPO-trained evidence selector
technical_details.publisher_claim: about 90% lower token consumption than the most efficient competing multimodal baseline
technical_details.code: MIT; training and evaluation scripts included
technical_details.license_limit: WorldMemArena upstream data is CC BY-NC 4.0

technical_details_zh.方法: 跨记忆关系图 + PPO 训练的证据选择器
technical_details_zh.发布方主张: token 用量比最省的多模态对照方法低约 90%
technical_details_zh.许可限制: 上游 WorldMemArena 数据为 CC BY-NC 4.0

events.title: Google broadens human-review terms for connected consumer Workspace data
events.title_zh: Google 扩大个人账户关联数据的人工审查范围
events.summary: Google updated its guidance on October 16: for consumer accounts that enable connected features, a subset of Workspace data used for personalization may train generative AI and may receive human review in limited circumstances. A community reproduction reports retrieval without explicit @Drive or @Gmail prompts, but that behavior has not been independently audited. Commercial Google Workspace accounts use separate data-processing terms.
events.why_it_matters: For users connecting personal Gmail or Drive to Gemini, the data boundary is broader than the old guidance and warrants a settings and sensitivity review. The community reproduction does not establish that every retrieval reaches human review.
events.summary_zh: Google 在 10 月 16 日更新说明：个人账户主动启用相关连接功能后，用于个性化体验的部分 Workspace 数据可能用于生成式 AI 训练，并在有限情况下接受人工审查。社区复现称 Gemini 会在未显式 @Drive 或 @Gmail 时检索个人内容；该行为尚无独立审计。Google Workspace 商业账户受另一套数据处理条款约束。
events.summary_en: Google updated its guidance on October 16: for consumer accounts that enable connected features, a subset of Workspace data used for personalization may train generative AI and may receive human review in limited circumstances. A community reproduction reports retrieval without explicit @Drive or @Gmail prompts, but that behavior has not been independently audited. Commercial Google Workspace accounts use separate data-processing terms.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对把个人 Gmail 或 Drive 连接到 Gemini 的用户来说，数据边界比旧说明更宽，需重新检查连接设置与敏感内容；社区复现不能证明所有请求都会进入人工审查。
events.why_it_matters_en: For users connecting personal Gmail or Drive to Gemini, the data boundary is broader than the old guidance and warrants a settings and sensitivity review. The community reproduction does not establish that every retrieval reaches human review.

events.title: Google adds TPU systems for confidential inference and massive context
events.title_zh: Google 新增机密推理与大上下文 TPU 系统
events.summary: Google announced two eighth-generation TPU system configurations. TPU 8tx applies confidential computing to inference and fine-tuning with sensitive models and data. TPU 8i Max combines two TPU 8i chips in one package for large contexts and higher rack density. The announcement also covers a preview TPU agent suite, open-source TPU Sync, and GA Cloud Pathways and GKE dynamic slicing.
events.why_it_matters: For teams planning self-hosted agent compute, isolation, memory hierarchy and dynamic slicing are converging in one system design. Performance and cost figures come from Google and cited partner evaluations, while actual SKU regions and quotas still require sales confirmation.
events.summary_zh: Google 发布 TPU 8tx 与 TPU 8i Max 两套第八代系统配置。8tx 将机密计算用于敏感模型与数据的推理和微调；8i Max 把两颗 TPU 8i 组合到一个封装中，面向大上下文和更高机架密度。公告同时披露 TPU agent suite 预览、TPU Sync 开源，以及 Cloud Pathways 和 GKE dynamic slicing GA。

TPU 8i Max combines two TPU 8i chips in one package for large contexts and higher rack density. The announcement also covers a preview TPU agent suite, open-source TPU Sync, and GA Cloud Pathways and GKE dynamic slicing.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对规划自托管 agent 算力的团队来说，安全隔离、内存层级和动态切片开始一起进入系统设计；性能与成本数字由 Google 与其引用的合作评测提供，实际 SKU 可用地区和配额仍需询价确认。

events.title: Notion says a Fireworks AI incident exposed some customer chat transcripts
events.title_zh: Notion 称 Fireworks AI 安全事件暴露部分客户聊天记录
events.summary: Notion says a Fireworks AI security incident affected fewer than 1% of its workspaces and exposed some Notion AI chat transcripts used by Insights. Notion disconnected Fireworks on November 3, disabled Insights and stopped serving open-weight models through the provider. Fireworks separately reports access to some account, billing, secret, dataset and incomplete-model data across a limited set of customers.
events.summary_en: Notion says a Fireworks AI security incident affected fewer than 1% of its workspaces and exposed some Notion AI chat transcripts used by Insights. Notion disconnected Fireworks on November 3, disabled Insights and stopped serving open-weight models through the provider. Fireworks separately reports access to some account, billing, secret, dataset and incomplete-model data across a limited set of customers.
events.summary_zh: Notion 称 Fireworks AI 安全事件影响不到 1% 的 workspace，并暴露了部分用于 Insights 的 Notion AI 聊天记录。Notion 已于 11 月 3 日断开 Fireworks、停用 Insights，并停止通过该 provider 提供开放权重模型。Fireworks 另称，少量客户的账户、账单、secret、dataset 与未完成模型数据也受到访问。
events.why_it_matters: For teams routing enterprise AI through inference providers, contractual zero-retention language did not prevent retained data from becoming incident scope. Affected Notion customers should review the provided export and rotate any credentials present in exposed chats.
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams routing enterprise AI through inference providers, contractual zero-retention language did not prevent retained data from becoming incident scope. Affected Notion customers should review the provided export and rotate any credentials present in exposed chats.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对通过第三方推理 provider 处理企业数据的团队来说，合同中的零保留承诺没有阻止保留数据进入事故范围。受影响的 Notion 客户应检查官方导出，并轮换聊天中出现的凭据。

technical_details.time_basis: Notion advisory updated 2026-11-09 with day precision; important recall-audit omission recorded as late discovery

technical_details_zh.Notion 范围: 不到 1% 的 Notion workspace；已直接联系受影响客户
technical_details_zh.受影响数据: 部分用于 Insights 的 Notion AI 聊天记录；Notion 称多数无法归属且不含 tool call 结果
technical_details_zh.处置: 断开 Fireworks、删除其中数据、停用 Insights、停止经 Fireworks 提供开放权重模型并停止训练
technical_details_zh.Fireworks 范围: 少量账户涉及账户/账单数据，部分还涉及 secret、dataset 与未完成模型权重
technical_details_zh.阶段: 调查仍在进行；Notion 建议把受影响数据视为已暴露
technical_details_zh.时间依据: Notion advisory 更新日期为 2026-11-09，仅有日期精度；作为召回自检发现的重要遗漏补录

events.next_action_zh: 若收到 Notion 通知，立即导出受影响记录，轮换其中的 API key、密码与 token，并复核所有推理 provider 的实际保留路径。
events.next_action_en: If Notion notified you, export affected records, rotate every API key, password and token present, and audit actual retention paths across inference providers.

evidence.claim_zh: Notion 与 Fireworks 的官方公告分别说明客户聊天记录及 provider 侧数据受到访问，调查仍在进行。
evidence.claim_en: Official Notion and Fireworks notices describe access to customer chat transcripts and provider-side data while the investigation remains ongoing.

changes.summary_zh: Notion 披露 Fireworks 事件暴露部分 AI 聊天记录。
changes.summary_en: Notion discloses that the Fireworks incident exposed some AI chat transcripts.
